help.occurrence_no: Occurrence number in Checkmate (tickets.occurrence_no). Click to open the original record.
help.sc_number: SAP service call number entered by the Service Desk (tickets.sc_number). Several occurrences can share the same SC#, especially in the imported history.
help.urgency: Urgency entered at creation: Overnight, Urgent or Normal (tickets.urgency). Not present in the imported history.
help.issue_reception_date: Date the request was received (tickets.issue_reception_date), used everywhere as the service call date (fiscal year, lists). The SAP call creation date is not stored.
help.delivery_date: Original delivery date of the order (tickets.delivery_date). Only entered since June 2026: missing from the imported history.
help.wish_delivery_date: Requested delivery date (tickets.wish_delivery_date), entered since June 2026.
help.occ_title: Occurrence title (tickets.quality_issue): the issue of its first line.
help.created_by_name: Person who created the occurrence in the app (tickets.created_by). Empty for the imported history. The “assigned to” field exists but is never filled.
help.record_origin: Entered in the app, or imported from the Excel history (occurrence without creator).
help.fiscal_year: Fiscal year of the reception date (December = month 1 of the next fiscal year).
help.lines_count: Total number of lines (items) of the occurrence, matched by the report or not.
help.ship_to: Delivery location / project site (tickets.ship_to), e.g. “HIEX Granby, QC”. Present in the imported history; no longer entered since June 25, 2026 (see “Project name”).
help.project_name: Project name (tickets.project_name), entered since June 2026 instead of Ship to.
help.sold_to: Billed customer (tickets.sold_to), e.g. “Hilton Supply Management”. Imported history; no longer entered since June 2026. The Clients registry is not linked to occurrences.
help.line_no: Position of the line within the occurrence. Empty for an imported occurrence without lines.
help.line_title: Issue of the line (occurrence_lines.quality_issue); occurrence title when it has no line.
help.item: Item number of the order line (occurrence_lines.line_item). For a single-line occurrence, falls back to the header item (Excel “Item” column of the history).
help.foliot_id: Foliot material code (occurrence_lines.foliot_id). For a single-line occurrence, falls back to the header “Material number / Foliot ID” (tickets.material_number). It is not the call number.
help.ref_so: Reference order (occurrence_lines.ref_so), header fallback for a single-line occurrence.
help.category: Defect category of the line (occurrence_lines.categories), falling back to the occurrence category when the line is not classified — same rule as the list and dashboard.
help.category_source: Whether the category comes from the line, from the header (fallback), or the item is unclassified.
help.department: Department of the line (occurrence_lines.department), header fallback.
help.root_cause: Root cause (occurrence_lines.root_cause, header fallback). Very rarely filled: 5 occurrences out of 2,432 in September 2026. No sub-cause exists in the platform.
help.plant: Plant of the line (occurrence_lines.plant), header fallback.
help.affected_qty: Affected quantity of the line (occurrence_lines.affected_qty); header fallback for a single-line occurrence.
help.total_qty: Total quantity of the item on the reference order (Excel column “Total qty on REF SO”). It is neither total deliveries nor production.
help.affected_pct_calc: Computed per item. When grouped: sum of affected quantities ÷ sum of total quantities of items that have both.
help.cost_furniture: Line “Cost furniture” bucket (occurrence_lines.cost_furniture): TOTAL line amount for pieces or furniture, not a unit cost. Left empty for single costs from before the breakdown (imported history and lines entered before July 9, 2026, never re-entered), which include freight.
help.cost_freight: Line “Cost freight” bucket (occurrence_lines.cost_freight). It belongs to the line, not the call, so it is never repeated.
help.freight_repeated: Yes when the same freight amount appears on several lines of the occurrence (55 occurrences in September 2026). It may be one call-level freight copied onto each line: platform totals count it on every line. Flagged, never deduplicated automatically.
help.supplier_credit: Supplier credit (occurrence_lines.supplier_credit, header fallback for a single-line occurrence). Already deducted from the total net cost.
help.cost_net: Line cost (occurrence_lines.cost_approx) = piece + freight + installation − credit: basis of every cost total in the platform. Imported history: Excel cost “shipping included”.
help.cost_split_status: Broken down (buckets entered in the app), not broken down (single pre-July 2026 cost: imported or entered before the breakdown, freight included), carried by the occurrence, or not specified.
help.occ_cost: Cost of the whole occurrence (sum of costed lines, otherwise header). Occurrence level: totals count it once per occurrence — do not sum it line by line in Excel.
help.meeting_date: Header meeting date (tickets.meeting_date), mostly present in the imported history.
help.review_meetings: Dates of the weekly reviews the occurrence was added to (meeting_tickets).
help.sd_completed_at: When the occurrence was submitted to the quality meeting (tickets.sd_completed_at).
help.text_line: Text search in the line issue and description. Distinct from the structured classification.
help.text_occ: Text search in the occurrence title, comment and Service Desk notes.
help.text_all: Text search in every text: line, occurrence, root cause, corrective action.
help.matched_criteria: Thematic criteria group(s) matched by the item. Orange: text search.
help.matched_lines: Number of matched items combined in this result row.
help.matched_occurrences: Number of matched occurrences combined in this result row.

groups.title: Thematic criteria
groups.logic: An item is kept if it matches AT LEAST ONE active group (OR). Within a group, every condition must be true (AND). Useful when the information is recorded in different fields.

granularity.title: One table row represents…
granularity.line_desc: 1 row = 1 item (occurrence line). An imported occurrence without lines appears once, with its header values.
granularity.occurrence_desc: 1 row = 1 occurrence (#). Values of matched items are combined; quantities and costs only add up matched items.
granularity.call_desc: 1 row = 1 service call (SC#), which may combine several occurrences. An occurrence without SC# forms its own row.
granularity.filter_level: Filters apply to items; calls and occurrences are always counted once.

summary.hint: Month, quarter or year on the period date field, or any classification field.
summary.title: Grouping
summary.total_note: Calls and occurrences are counted once: a call present in several groups (e.g. two plants) appears in each, so the sum of groups can exceed the total. Quantities and costs: each item belongs to a single group, so groups add up exactly to the total.
summary.share_of: {{calls}} calls out of {{scope}} in the group scope

kpi.calls_note: including {{n}} occurrence(s) without SC# counted separately
kpi.scope_calls_note: same period and filters, without the thematic criteria
kpi.share_note: Share of calls = matched calls ÷ calls in scope (same period, same filters, without the thematic criteria). It is not a defect rate on delivered products: the platform has no delivered quantities, and a line's “Total qty” only concerns its order.
kpi.legacy_note: including {{amount}} on {{n}} item(s) with a single cost from before the breakdown (July 2026): freight included, not broken down
kpi.freight_repeated_note: same amount on several lines of {{n}} occurrence(s): up to {{amount}} too much if it is a call freight copied onto lines

notes.granularity: Filters are evaluated item by item; an occurrence or call with several items is never counted several times in call or occurrence counts.
notes.share: “Share of calls” is not a defect rate on delivered products: there is no delivered-units base in the platform, and “Total qty” only concerns the line's order.
notes.legacy_cost: Single cost from before the 3-bucket breakdown (July 9, 2026) — Excel history and lines entered before that date, never re-entered: freight included, not broken down. It is included in “Total net cost” but neither in “Cost (piece / furniture)” nor “Cost (freight)”.
notes.cost_piece: “Cost (piece / furniture)” is the total line amount, not a unit cost (no unit cost is recorded).
notes.freight_repeated: “Freight repeated on several lines”: the same freight amount copied onto an occurrence's lines may be a call freight counted several times. No field can confirm it; amounts are exported as entered and the possible excess is shown in the summary.
notes.root_cause: Root cause very rarely filled; no sub-cause exists in the platform.
notes.ship_to: “Ship to” and “Sold to” are no longer entered since June 25, 2026; “Project name” replaces them for new occurrences.
notes.delivery_date: “Original delivery date”: entered since June 2026 only.
notes.responsible: Owner: only “Created by” is available (the “assigned to” field is never filled); empty for the imported history.
notes.currency: No currency is recorded: amounts are added as entered, as everywhere else in the platform.
notes.sc_shared: One SC# may combine several occurrences; an occurrence without SC# is counted as a distinct call.
notes.textual: Groups marked “text search” rely on descriptions, not on the classification: no data is reclassified.

hardware_missing.description: No field distinguishes missing hardware: the template combines the category (Hardware, Missing Component) with a text search in the description, group by group, without reclassifying data.
